mentions.name: Akkuplan
mentions.description: This app optimizes electric car charging by planning multiple days ahead to make the best use of low electricity prices and surplus solar. It can control charging through the vehicle API or the charger API.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building a better charging optimisation for electric cars.

It plans multiple days ahead to make the best use of low prices and surplus solar.

It can use the vehicle api or the charger api to control charging.
